parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
Personal access token.  
This field is not required when using Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID and AccessKey Secret or Security Token Service (STS) temporary authorization.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The enterprise identity, also known as the enterprise ID, is a string that can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Default value is 1, starting from page 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size. Default value is 20. Valid range: [1, 100]

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sorting method. Default value is updated_desc.
- updated_desc: sort by update time in descending order
- updated_asc: sort by update time in ascending order
